# VoxDonna

> VoxDonna (legal name: Donna AI Labs Private Limited) is a full-stack AI
> consulting company. It builds custom AI agents — voice, WhatsApp and
> sales/LinkedIn outreach — that integrate with a client's existing ERP or
> CRM. 37 agents shipped across 12 industries as of 2026. Founder: Suyash
> Raj (also at rajsuyash.com). Sister company: AiSewak (aisewak.com),
> building government/public-sector voice AI.
>
> Not affiliated with "Donna" (askdonna.com) or "HireDonna"
> (linkedin.com/company/hiredonna) — unrelated companies that also use the
> name "Donna."

## Case studies (with sourced, quantified outcomes)
- [Le Marquier](https://voxdonna.com/case-studies/le-marquier.html): French outdoor-cooking brand; 24/7 multilingual support (FR/EN/IT), support cost -80%, CSAT 3.7→4.6
- [Usha Martin](https://voxdonna.com/case-studies/usha-martin.html): wire-rope manufacturer, 24/7 complaint voice agent

## Original research
- [10,000 Business Calls Analyzed](https://voxdonna.com/blog/en/analyzed-10000-business-calls-ai.html): 73% of calls across 50 small businesses followed AI-automatable patterns
- [Voice AI Quality Benchmarks](https://voxdonna.com/blog/en/voice-ai-latency-quality-benchmarks.html): latency, interruption-handling and handoff-quality benchmarks for voice AI deployments
